A little clarity

Good questions.
Honest answers.

Have something else in mind? Tell us what you're planning. We're happy to talk it through.

Ask us on WhatsApp ↗
What kinds of businesses do you work with?

We build websites for local businesses, professionals, growing brands and online stores. Whether you need a first website, a dedicated landing page or a redesign, we start with your goals and recommend a practical scope.

How much does a website cost?

It depends on the pages, content, design and features you need. After a short conversation, we'll share a custom quote with a clear scope. Domain, hosting and any paid tools are discussed before you commit.

How long will my website take?

We agree on a timeline after defining the scope. The number of pages, integrations, content readiness and feedback rounds all affect delivery. You'll know the key milestones before the project begins.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. Share your current website and what isn't working for you. We'll review the structure, design and visitor journey, then plan a redesign around the improvements that matter to your business.

Do you help with hosting, domain and launch?

Yes, we can help with setup and launch. We'll discuss suitable options and clarify any recurring provider costs in your proposal so you understand what you're paying for.

What happens after the website launches?

We help with the agreed launch handover. If you'd like ongoing support, our monthly care plan can cover content updates, small fixes and improvements. Larger new features are scoped separately.

How does the WhatsApp enquiry form work?

The form prepares your project details as a WhatsApp message. WhatsApp opens so you can review it and press Send. Your enquiry is sent only when you do that, and a preferred call date is a request rather than a confirmed appointment.

Your information

A simple privacy note.

This website does not store your form entries or send them to a website database. Completing the form prepares a message on your device.

When you continue on WhatsApp

The details you enter are included in a WhatsApp link. WhatsApp receives those details when you open it. The message reaches Pixelnest only after you press Send in WhatsApp. WhatsApp's own privacy policies apply to your use of its service.

Only share what you need to

Please don't include passwords, payment details or other sensitive information in your project enquiry. You can contact Pixelnest through WhatsApp with questions about information you have shared.

Other websites

Portfolio links open external websites. Those websites have their own data practices.
